sourceHead: desktop sections: working tree after ce271b9; 390px mobile: 585ae28e36295edb2d69c044af045863f20179fe (HUD-wrap fix)

mobileRecapture.method: Playwright CDP Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride at 390x844 with deviceScaleFactor 1; the exact regenerated preview documents were loaded from the owner-authenticated preview origin; touchstart/touchend were dispatched on the shipped handlers; bitmap and CSS box were read from the live canvas after the HUD wrapped.

environment.browser: Cloud Chromium via the Freebuff cloud browser panel

documents.csp: default-src 'none'; script-src 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src data:; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'
documents.hostInjectedScriptBlocked: https://static.cloudflareinsights.com/beacon.min.js/... was blocked by the generated CSP
consoleErrors: CSP blocked the preview-host-injected Cloudflare beacon

autonomousController.method: in-browser BFS over measured collision geometry, replanning on stalls

limitations: Chromium only; Safari, Firefox and real iOS/Android were not tested.
Touch was exercised with dispatched touchstart/touchend events on the real handlers after mouse input was verified with real pointer events.
Audio synthesis was verified by a running AudioContext and an oscillator created on jump; audible output was not captured.
The browser controller is acceptance-test code, not the Native Gaming Agent runtime; it does not make the agent a cloud-browser player.
Performance metrics come from Chrome DevTools Protocol on one desktop VM sample; they are not a cross-device benchmark.
No hosted browser CI exists at zero cost, so this evidence is for the two reference builds at the recorded heads.
The 390px mobile figures were re-captured at 585ae28e36295edb2d69c044af045863f20179fe after the HUD-wrap fix; the desktop sections remain the earlier ce271b9 capture and were not re-run.
The mobile re-capture ran at deviceScaleFactor 1. The 2x device-pixel path is covered by the DOM harness (browser.boot), not this browser run.
